Here’s how our dirt removal service works: First, we give you a free, transparent quote with no hidden charges. Our trained team takes every precaution, using protective equipment to safeguard your property during the removal process.

blocks.text: What to Expect from Our Dirt Removal Service
You’ll love how effortlessly we make dirt removal!

items: We clear soil and debris from anywhere on your property – tight backyard corners, sloped areas, or large open spaces. Our crews take extreme care to protect your landscaping and surfaces during removal.

It doesn’t matter what type of dirt or debris you need removed – from light topsoil to heavy clay, from clean fill to construction rubble. We have the proper equipment and expertise to handle all kinds of earth materials safely and efficiently.

The best part? You don’t lift a finger! We do all the heavy shoveling and hauling. When we’re done, your space will be clean and level, ready for new projects or simply enjoying your clutter-free property.

items.q: Do you remove all types of dirt, including construction debris?
a: Yes, we remove all dirt types, topsoil, clay, sand, clean fill, and construction debris. Our team is equipped for residential and commercial projects of any complexity.

items.q: How much does dirt removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125 for basic removal. Larger quantities get volume discounts. Get free exact pricing by sharing project details via text/photo. No hidden fees, the quote includes labor, hauling, and disposal.

items.q: What areas do you serve for dirt removal?
a: We cover the Greater Toronto Area. Contact us to confirm service for your specific address. Same-day availability varies by location.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day dirt removal service?
a: Yes! Same-day service is available for urgent projects, subject to crew availability. Weekend appointments are offered at no extra cost.

items.q: Do you handle large quantities of dirt removal?
a: Absolutely. Our teams handle small garden cleanouts to construction-scale projects. Special equipment ensures efficient removal for bulk quantities. Just ask about our excavator and dump truck services.
